claims.source_quote_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَغْفِرُ أَنْ يُشْرَكَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرُ ما دُونَ ذلِكَ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ
claims.claim_ar: مقابلة في النفي والإثبات: نفي مغفرة نوع من الذنوب وإثبات مغفرة أنواع أخرى؛ التقابل هذا يقوّي القطع والنفي ويظهر التمييز بين حالتين.
claims.claim_en: Antithesis (muqabalah): a juxtaposition of negation and affirmation—negating forgiveness for one category of sin while affirming forgiveness for others; this contrast strengthens the categorical negation and highlights the distinction between two cases.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted explanatory passage in the sources discusses a verse about shirk and contrasts denial/affirmation there; applying the same rhetorical pattern to 4:168 (negation of forgiveness/guidance) is inferential rather than directly cited.

claims.claim_ar: استعمال صيغ النفي التنزيهية (ما كان/لم يكن) لنفي إمكانية أو لزوم وقوع أمرٍ ما على جهة الاحتمال أو الاستحقاق؛ في سياق الآية يمنع عن الكفار الظالمين احتمال حصول مغفرة أو هداية.
claims.claim_en: Restrictive-limiting negation (hasr_qasr): use of negation formulas like 'ma kana/lam yakun' to deny the possibility or propriety of something occurring; in the verse this construction excludes the possibility that Allah would forgive or guide those who disbelieve and do wrong.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source example uses 'ما كان' (ma kana) while the verse uses 'لم يكن' (lam yakun); the functions are closely related but the forms differ—requires review to confirm exact correspondence.

warnings: The provided source chunks are from al-Kashshaf (Zamakhshari). The developer instruction named other commentators (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir-balagha); those were not present in the given chunks.

Some source quotations discuss a different verse (not S4:168) — claims extrapolate rhetorical patterns from those discussions to the target ayah; such inferences should be reviewed against direct commentary on S4:168.
